_comment: Single source of truth for QA rules. Edit here only — qa_validate.py reads this at runtime.
_output_format_comment: WS2 routing backbone. type drives which validation families the spine runs for this artifact shape; structured_json means the artifact is a single JSON object validated by jsonschema (Layer 1) plus the claim/source deterministic checks. schema.manifest_path is repo-relative; when present, Layer-1 jsonschema validation runs against that manifest's output_schema before any other check. inline_citation_pattern is the regex the generic inline-citation extractor uses to pull citation tokens out of prose (meeting_briefing cites via bracketed source ids like [src_1]).
_citation_paths_comment: Prose paths the new Layer A citation checks (citation_label_url_coherence, social_media_citation, urls_resolve) scan for inline [Label](URL) citations. Meeting briefings rarely embed inline citations (provenance lives in claims[]/sources[] instead), so this list is empty by default — the checks self-skip when empty. Populate per-product when a product produces inline-cited prose.
_label_domain_map_comment: Label-to-expected-host map for citation_label_url_coherence. Empty for meeting_briefing; populated for products that cite external publishers.
_url_check_comment: Opt-in HTTP liveness for cited URLs. enabled:false means urls_resolve self-skips even when --check-urls is passed.
_coherence_check_comment: Per-item coherence between display.summary and the item's combined source_extracts. Verdict: warn when BOTH TF-IDF cosine AND containment fall below their thresholds AND a semantic embedding cosine (when available) does not rescue the item above embedding_check.rescue_threshold. The lexical AND guards against single-metric false positives; the embedding rescue guards against the residual paraphrase false-positive that lexical metrics can't distinguish from drift. ROUGE-L is recorded per item in qa_bundle.details for diagnostic value but does NOT drive the verdict (brittle n-gram metric that penalizes faithful paraphrasing). Thresholds calibrated against Round-4 Kemah artifact 2026-05-18 — variants A–D pass, variants E–I fail.
_embedding_check_comment: Semantic rescue signal for summary_source_coherence. When both lexical signals (TF-IDF and containment) fall below their thresholds, qa_validate.py computes a sentence-embedding cosine via the named local model and downgrades the warn to pass when embedding_cosine >= rescue_threshold. Catches faithful paraphrases where the summary uses different vocabulary than the source extracts to express the same meaning. Set enabled:false to revert to lexical-only behavior. all-MiniLM-L6-v2 default is ~22MB, runs on CPU, deterministic per model version. Rescue threshold 0.70 is a defensible starting point — paraphrases of the same fact typically cluster in [0.70, 0.95], topical-but-different sentences in [0.40, 0.65]; recalibrate against the Kemah variant suite if model is changed.
_structured_validators_comment: WS2 P0. Per-claim-type opt-in deterministic extraction + exact match for high-stakes literals. For each declared claim_type, the spine extracts every token of the named kind from claim_text and requires each to appear, normalized, in the retrieved_text_or_snapshot of at least one cited source. kind is one of: money, date, name, vote_count, legal_citation, percentage. rounding_tolerance (money/percentage only) permits a numeric delta; absent or 0 means exact. These are extraction rules, not calibrated thresholds — the only numeric (rounding_tolerance) is 0 (exact) here because no rounding behavior was prompt-derivable; any non-zero tolerance must come from a committed fixture, never invented. Violations on high-weight/blockable claim types block; others annotate.
_source_hierarchy_comment: WS2 P0. Spec-declared claim_type -> allowed source_types. A claim of a listed type may only cite sources whose source_type is in its allow-list; a violating claim is flagged. A claim_type with NO entry here yields a non-blocking diagnostic that surfaces the policy gap (not a hard block, not silent-allow). source_type values match the manifest output_schema source enum: agenda_packet, news, government_website, campaign, haystaq.
_embedding_rescue_blocklist_comment: WS2 P0. Deny-list of claim_types for which the summary_source_coherence embedding rescue is forbidden: numbers, dates, names, vote counts, legal citations, and allegations must never be rescued by semantic similarity (embedding cosine is brittle against small factual swaps, e.g. $1.8M vs $2M scoring ~0.99). When ANY claim feeding an item's coherence comparison is of a blocklisted type, the embedding rescue is refused for that item and the lexical verdict stands. Absence from this list means a type stays rescuable.
_judges_comment: Phase 1 and Phase 2 judges by name. Names resolve via the QA_JUDGES env var (format: name:provider:model,...). Same-family Anthropic (Sonnet Phase 1 + Opus Phase 2 with adversarial system prompt) is the in-Fargate production path — broker proxies Anthropic only, no cross-family egress. Cross-family (Anthropic + Google/OpenAI) is preferred for independent second-opinion when both providers are reachable; deferred until/if a broker route for Google or other providers exists.
_completeness_comment: min_executive_summary_chars is measured as len(executive_summary.lead_in) + sum(len(it.overview) for it in executive_summary.items). 250 covers a tight single-featured agenda (~70 lead + ~180 overview) and is well under the 3-item prototype (~620). Ceremonial agendas with items: [] still pass when the standalone lead_in is substantive; otherwise warn.

completeness._field_paths_comment: WS2 decouple. completeness_floor walks these spec-declared paths instead of hard-coded meeting_briefing field names. exec_summary_overview_paths feed the executive-summary length measurement; total_prose_paths feed the word-count measurement. Paths use the _values_at_path notation (parent.items[].leaf). When exec_summary_overview_paths is absent/empty, the exec-summary length sub-check warns (skip-with-warning) instead of silently undercounting. priority_item_overview_field is the per-priority-item display field measured against min_overview_chars_per_priority_item.

field_paths._exec_summary_overview_scope_comment: Only items[] entries matching priority_filter (tier==featured) contribute their overview to the exec-summary length. Queued/standard items must never inflate the count even if they carry a (schema-invalid) overview.

_polish_comment: Deterministic regex polish on EO-facing prose. Findings are annotations (never block); the agent reads qa_bundle.json and can fix specific locations via the per-finding 'path' field, then re-run. Patterns are intentionally conservative — false positives are worse than misses for a non-blocking check.

deterministic_checks.description: WS2 Layer-1. jsonschema (draft-07) validation of the whole artifact against the manifest output_schema named by output_format.schema, run before any other check. Staged as annotate (warning) for a trial window — surfaces shape drift without blocking; will be promoted to block once briefings are confirmed to conform. Skipped with a warning when output_format.schema is absent or the manifest/jsonschema is unavailable. Does not re-penalize artifacts already blocked by load (invalid JSON) — those never reach Layer 1. (Routing is driven by code, not by reading this field; this value is descriptive.)

WS2 P0. Per-claim-type (structured_validators) deterministic extraction + exact match for high-stakes literals (money, dates, names, vote counts, legal citations, percentages). Every literal of the declared kind in claim_text must appear, normalized, in a cited source snapshot. High-weight/blockable claim-type failures block; others annotate.

WS2 P0. Spec-declared claim_type -> allowed source_types (source_hierarchy). A claim citing a source whose source_type is not allowed for its claim_type is flagged; high-weight/blockable violations block, others annotate. A claim_type with no source_hierarchy entry yields a non-blocking diagnostic surfacing the policy gap.
Every field in spec.identity_fields must be present and non-empty at the top level of the artifact
When briefing_status matches priority_required_status, at least one item must match priority_filter
Every high-weight or blockable claim must carry at least one non-empty source_extract

Every claim (regardless of weight) must carry at least one source_id AND at least one non-empty source_extract. Belt-and-suspenders with high_weight_claims_have_extracts which only covers the high-weight subset. Routes block if any failing claim is high-weight or blockable; annotates otherwise.
Every source_id referenced by a claim must resolve to a source in the artifact's sources[]
Every source must carry non-empty retrieved_text_or_snapshot content
Prose at the paths in prohibited_phrase_paths must not match any pattern in prohibited_phrases (talking_points and other override sections are exempt by being excluded from prohibited_phrase_paths)

Every source_extract on a claim must appear (exact substring or fuzzy match >= substring_check.fuzzy_threshold) in the retrieved_text_or_snapshot of at least one of the claim's cited source_ids. Search is bounded to cited sources only — never wanders. High-weight failures block; lower-weight failures annotate.

Per priority item, summary vs combined source_extracts is scored on TF-IDF cosine AND containment. Warns when BOTH below thresholds in coherence_check (independent signals must agree). Catches summaries that drifted from cited evidence. ROUGE-L is logged per item as info-only.

Artifact must meet the floors declared in spec.completeness (min priority items, min character lengths, min total prose words). Floors are minimums, not goals — most briefings should comfortably exceed them.

Deterministic regex polish on EO-facing prose fields (executive_summary, per-item summary/budget/sentiment summaries, talking_points). Catches doubled words, double spaces, common typos, trailing whitespace. Never blocks; each finding carries a path so the agent can locate and fix it before final write.
Inline [Label](URL) citations on spec.citation_paths must point at a host matching spec.label_domain_map. Self-skips when either is empty.
Inline citations on spec.citation_paths must not point at social-media hosts (Twitter/X, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok). Self-skips when citation_paths is empty.

Opt-in via --check-urls CLI flag AND spec.url_check.enabled. HEAD probe (with GET retry on 403/405) every URL cited inline on spec.citation_paths; non-200 surfaces as a warning. Self-skips when either gate is off.
